OFP Viewer for Android — the same reader as the web app, as an installed app,
laid out for folding phones: folded it reads like a phone, unfolded the same
screens open out to the full width, and folding or unfolding keeps your place.

**Install:** download `OFP-Viewer.apk` on the phone and open it. The first time,
Android asks to allow installs from that app (the browser or Files) — allow it.
Each later build installs over this one and keeps the open plan.

Open a plan from the app, or "Open with" / "Share" a PDF to **OFP Viewer** from
Files, Mail or Telegram. The plan is read on the phone; nothing is sent anywhere.

See `android/README.md`.
